title: The agent suite, CI and the config command still assume OpenCode 1

evidence.verified: `make ci` passed on 1ce87b1's tree, with OpenCode 2.2.5 on the host. `make test-smoke` passed all four committed cassettes, opencode-fireworks among them. `CS_VCR_AGENTS=1 CS_VCR_AGENTS_STRICT=1 go test ./test/agents -run 'TestReplayFixtures/opencode-fireworks$' -count=1` passed, as CI runs it. The re-recording on 2.2.5 reported the cassette clean of host identity.

resolution: The suite runs OpenCode 2 with `--standalone` and points it at cs-vcr through `providers.<id>.settings.baseURL` in `opencode.json`. CI runs the v2 installer to get it. `cs-vcr config opencode` prints that block, or the same JSON in `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`, and no base-URL variable. opencode-fireworks is re-recorded on 2.2.5. The port lives on the opencode-v2.x branch, and main stays on OpenCode 1.19.5.
details:
OpenCode 2 changes three things cs-vcr relies on. It reads no base-URL variable for any provider, so `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_BASE_URL` no longer point it at cs-vcr. Its config file keys a provider's base URL as `providers.<id>.settings.baseURL` rather than `provider.<id>.options.baseURL`. And `opencode run` reaches a background service that keeps the environment it was started with. The proxy, key and base URL a run sets reach it only when the run takes `--standalone`.

The agent suite, CI's installer, `cs-vcr config opencode`, README and MANUAL all assumed OpenCode 1. The committed opencode-fireworks cassette was recorded on 1.19.5, so no OpenCode 2 host could replay it.
